steps.note: A recording open with nothing playing should leave the Mac alone. The six transition tiles and the five caption style tiles each redrew thirty times a second, and every redraw laid the whole window out again: a 1.5s wait read 881ms of main thread busy and never went quiet (2026-09-27). Their loops now play on Core Animation, drawn once, so the same two seconds read tens of milliseconds. The walk fails at 400ms busy in two seconds, a fifth of the time, well under the 1200ms the old tiles cost and well over what the quiet app reads.
Nothing picked: the Transitions tiles play in the panel.
A caption picked: the five caption style tiles play their words too.
Two pictures a moment apart: the tiles' words have moved on between them.
